title: WPMS/1653/2007 of M/S PARAS ELECTRICALS LTD. Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1653 of 2007
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Sharad Sharma, Sr. Advocate assisted by Ms.
Vandana Singh, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, Standing Counsel for State
of Uttarakhand / respondent no. 2.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for respondents no. 1
and 3 / SIDCUL / review applicant.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for respondent no. 1
and 3 / review applicant submits that alternative plot
bearing no. 94 N-2 measuring 2100 sq. mts. has been
offered to the petitioner and he has accepted the offer of
SIDCUL. He further contends that since this plot is two-side open, therefore, petitioner should pay 5% extra
premium, on the rate prevailing at the time of original
allotment.
Mr. Sharad Sharma, Sr. Advocate assisted by Ms.
Vandana Singh, Advocate for the petitioner submits that
petitioner shall pay additional premium of 5% on the rate
prevailing at the time of original allotment, however,
SIDCUL should intimate the amount of 5% additional
premium within a week and thereafter, entire formalities
shall be completed pertaining to allotment and delivery of
the possession within 45 days from today.
Learned counsel for the parties submit that present
MCC No. 285 of 2015 be disposed of in the light of
statements recorded hereinbefore.
Ordered accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 06.05.2015
SKS
